description: This file provides utility functions for the backend API, including ID generation, timestamp retrieval, JSON serialization, hashing, and error response creation.

methods.name: str generate_id(prefix: str = "")
methods.description: Generate a unique identifier, optionally with a prefix.

methods.name: str utc_now_iso()
methods.description: Get current UTC timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

methods.name: str canonical_json(data: Any)
methods.description: Serialize data to canonical JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace.

methods.name: str compute_hash(data: Any)
methods.description: Compute SHA-256 hash of various data types.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] make_error_response(code: str, message: str, correlation_id: str, details: Dict[str, Any] = None)
methods.description: Create a standardized error response dictionary.

ctags.name: make_error_response
ctags.pattern: /^def make_error_response(code: str, message: str, correlation_id: str, details: Dict[str, Any] = /
ctags.signature: (code: str, message: str, correlation_id: str, details: Dict[str, Any] = None)
